description: Publishes a board and returns a link that opens it in the user's browser. Call check_board first. A board with errors is not published: the problems come back instead. Give the link to the user exactly as returned.

text.description: The whole board in the Math Board format: # title, ## pages, Markdown with $...$ formulas, :::graph, :::geometry, :::solid blocks, and :::comment, :::say blocks and :::mood lines under ### step headings. The ~~~mathboard fence around it is optional.

name: publish_board
title: Publish a board
